passages.text: Shortly before the LORD took Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal, and Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Bethel.” But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD planned to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind.
Elijah was a prophet.
Elisha was his disciple.
Elijah and Elisha left Gilgal together.
Elijah spoke to Elisha.
Elijah said, “Please stay here.”
Elijah said, “The LORD has sent me to Bethel.”
Elisha answered Elijah.
Elisha said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will not leave you.”
Elisha said, “As surely as you live, I will not leave you.”
Elijah and Elisha went down to Bethel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהַעֲל֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֵלִיָּ֛הוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁ֖ע מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁ֜ע שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי עַד־ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּרְד֖וּ בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then the sons of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?” “Yes, I know,” he replied. “Do not speak of it.”
passages.sermon:
The sons of the prophets lived at Bethel.
They came out to Elisha.
They spoke to Elisha.
They said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?”
Elisha answered them.
He said, “Yes, I know.”
He said, “Do not speak of it.”
passages.original: וַיֵּצְא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בֵּֽית־ אֵל֮ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־ אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃

passages.text: And Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Jericho.” But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.” So they went to Jericho.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elisha was his disciple.
Elijah spoke to Elisha.
Elijah said, “Please stay here.”
Elijah said, “The LORD has sent me to Jericho.”
Elisha answered Elijah.
Elisha said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will not leave you.”
Elisha said, “As surely as you live, I will not leave you.”
Elijah and Elisha went to Jericho.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע׀ שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי יְרִיח֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then the sons of the prophets at Jericho came up to Elisha and said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?” “Yes, I know,” he replied. “Do not speak of it.”
passages.sermon:
The sons of the prophets lived in Jericho.
They came to Elisha.
They spoke to Elisha.
They said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?”
Elisha answered them.
He said, “Yes, I know.”
He said, “Do not speak of it.”
passages.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בִּֽירִיחוֹ֮ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־ אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃

passages.text: And Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to the Jordan.” But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.” So the two of them went on.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elisha was his disciple.
Elijah spoke to Elisha.
Elijah said, “Please stay here.”
Elijah said, “The LORD has sent me to the Jordan.”
Elisha answered Elijah.
Elisha said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will not leave you.”
Elisha said, “As surely as you live, I will not leave you.”
Elijah and Elisha went on together.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing Elijah and Elisha as the two of them stood by the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Fifty men were sons of the prophets.
They went to the place near the Jordan River.
They stood far away from Elijah and Elisha.
Elijah and Elisha stood together by the Jordan River.
The fifty men watched them from a distance.
passages.original: וַחֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֤י הַנְּבִיאִים֙ הָֽלְכ֔וּ וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ מִנֶּ֖גֶד מֵרָח֑וֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם עָמְד֥וּ עַל־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: And Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up, and struck the waters, which parted to the right and to the left, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
Elijah took his cloak.
He rolled up his cloak.
He struck the water with his cloak.
The water parted to the right and to the left.
Elijah and Elisha crossed over on dry ground.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶת־ אַדַּרְתּ֤וֹ וַיִּגְלֹם֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֵּחָצ֖וּ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֑נָּה וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בֶּחָרָבָֽה׃

passages.text: After they had crossed over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken away from you?” “Please, let me inherit a double portion of your spirit,” Elisha replied.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
Elisha was his disciple.
The two men crossed the Jordan River together.
After they crossed, Elijah spoke to Elisha.
Elijah said, “Tell me what I can do for you.”
Elijah said this before he would be taken away from Elisha.
Elisha answered Elijah.
Elisha said, “Please let me receive a double portion of your spirit.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְעָבְרָ֗ם וְאֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ אָמַ֤ר אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֙ שְׁאַל֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֶלָּקַ֣ח מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וִֽיהִי־ נָ֛א פִּֽי־ שְׁנַ֥יִם בְּרוּחֲךָ֖ אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: “You have requested a difficult thing,” said Elijah. “Nevertheless, if you see me as I am taken from you, it will be yours. But if not, then it will not be so.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
\r\nElijah spoke to Elisha.
\r\nElijah said, “You have asked for a difficult thing.”
\r\nElijah said, “If you see me when I am taken from you, you will receive it.”
\r\nElijah said, “If you do not see me, you will not receive it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִקְשִׁ֣יתָ לִשְׁא֑וֹל אִם־ תִּרְאֶ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לֻקָּ֤ח מֵֽאִתָּךְ֙ יְהִֽי־ לְךָ֣ כֵ֔ן וְאִם־ אַ֖יִן לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up into heaven in a whirlwind.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
Elisha was his disciple.
Elijah and Elisha walked together.
They talked as they walked.
Suddenly, a chariot of fire appeared.
Horses of fire appeared with the chariot.
The chariot and horses separated Elijah and Elisha.
A whirlwind came.
Elijah went up into heaven in the whirlwind.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י הֵ֣מָּה הֹלְכִ֤ים הָלוֹךְ֙ וְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֤ה רֶֽכֶב־ אֵשׁ֙ וְס֣וּסֵי אֵ֔שׁ וַיַּפְרִ֖דוּ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּ֙עַל֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: As Elisha watched, he cried out, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!” And he saw Elijah no more. So taking hold of his own clothes, he tore them in two.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet.
Elisha watched Elijah.
Elisha cried out loudly.
He said, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!”
Elisha could not see Elijah anymore.
Elisha grabbed his own clothes.
He tore his clothes into two pieces.
passages.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֣ע רֹאֶ֗ה וְה֤וּא מְצַעֵק֙ אָבִ֣י׀ אָבִ֗י רֶ֤כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפָ֣רָשָׁ֔יו וְלֹ֥א רָאָ֖הוּ ע֑וֹד וַֽיַּחֲזֵק֙ בִּבְגָדָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָעֵ֖ם לִשְׁנַ֥יִם קְרָעִֽים׃

passages.text: Elisha also picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah, and he went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Elisha saw Elijah’s cloak on the ground.
Elijah’s cloak had fallen from him.
Elisha picked up Elijah’s cloak.
Elisha returned to the Jordan River.
Elisha stood on the bank of the Jordan River.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙רֶם֙ אֶת־ אַדֶּ֣רֶת אֵלִיָּ֔הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָפְלָ֖ה מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֥שָׁב וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Then he took the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the waters. “Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” he asked. And when he had struck the waters, they parted to the right and to the left, and Elisha crossed over.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
\r\nElijah was his master and a prophet of God.
\r\nElijah had just been taken away from Elisha.
\r\nElisha took Elijah’s cloak.
\r\nThe cloak had fallen from Elijah.
\r\nElisha struck the waters of the Jordan River with the cloak.
\r\nElisha said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?”
\r\nElisha struck the waters again.
\r\nThe waters parted to the right and to the left.
\r\nElisha crossed over the river.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־ אַדֶּ֨רֶת אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֲשֶׁר־ נָפְלָ֤ה מֵֽעָלָיו֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אַיֵּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ אַף־ ה֣וּא׀ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיֵּֽחָצוּ֙ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֔נָּה וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֱלִישָֽׁע׃

passages.text: When the sons of the prophets who were facing him from Jericho saw what had happened, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” And they went to meet him and bowed down to the ground before him.
passages.sermon:
The sons of the prophets were in Jericho.
They saw Elisha from a distance.
They saw what had happened to him.
They said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.”
They went to meet Elisha.
They bowed down to the ground before him.
passages.original: וַיִּרְאֻ֨הוּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ בִּֽירִיחוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָ֛חָה ר֥וּחַ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ עַל־ אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: “Look now,” they said to Elisha, “we your servants have fifty valiant men. Please let them go and search for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and put him on one of the mountains or in one of the valleys.” “Do not send them,” Elisha replied.
passages.sermon:
The sons of the prophets spoke to Elisha.
They said, “We are your servants.
We have fifty strong men.
Let them go and search for your master.
Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has carried him away.
Maybe the Spirit has put him on one of the mountains.
Or maybe the Spirit has put him in one of the valleys.”
Elisha said, “Do not send them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֡יו הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א יֵֽשׁ־ אֶת־ עֲבָדֶיךָ֩ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּנֵֽי־ חַ֗יִל יֵ֣לְכוּ נָא֮ וִיבַקְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶיךָ֒ פֶּן־ נְשָׂאוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד הֶהָרִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּאַחַ֣ת הַגְּיָאוֹת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֥א תִשְׁלָֽחוּ׃

passages.text: But when they pressed him to the point of embarrassment, he said, “Send them.” And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find Elijah.
passages.sermon:
The sons of the prophets spoke to Elisha.
They insisted that he let them search for Elijah.
They pressed him until he felt embarrassed.
Elisha said, “Send them.”
They sent fifty men.
The fifty men searched for Elijah for three days.
They did not find Elijah.
passages.original: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־ ב֥וֹ עַד־ בֹּ֖שׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלָ֑חוּ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־ יָמִ֖ים וְלֹ֥א מְצָאֻֽהוּ׃

passages.text: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you not to go?”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
Elisha stayed in the city of Jericho.
The fifty men returned to Elisha.
Elisha spoke to them.
Elisha said, “Didn’t I tell you not to go?”
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֵלָ֔יו וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּירִיח֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הֲלֽוֹא־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם אַל־ תֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: Then the men of the city said to Elisha, “Please note, our lord, that the city’s location is good, as you can see. But the water is bad and the land is unfruitful.”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
He was staying in Jericho.
The men of the city spoke to Elisha.
They said, “Our lord, please look at our city.
The city’s location is good.
You can see this for yourself.
But the water here is bad.
The land does not produce fruit.
The land causes loss and unfruitfulness.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָעִיר֙ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה־ נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָעִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י רֹאֶ֑ה וְהַמַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְהָאָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: “Bring me a new bowl,” he replied, “and put some salt in it.” So they brought it to him, and Elisha went out to the spring, cast the salt into it, and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘I have healed this water. No longer will it cause death or unfruitfulness.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of the LORD.
The men of the city spoke to Elisha about their problem.
The water in the city was bad.
The land was unfruitful.
Elisha said, “Bring me a new bowl.”
He told them, “Put some salt in it.”
They brought the bowl with salt to Elisha.
Elisha went out to the spring of water.
He threw the salt into the spring.
Elisha said, “This is what the LORD says.”
The LORD says, “I have healed this water.”
The water will not cause death anymore.
The water will not cause unfruitfulness anymore.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קְחוּ־ לִי֙ צְלֹחִ֣ית חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וְשִׂ֥ימוּ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיִּקְח֖וּ אֵלָֽיו׃ וַיֵּצֵא֙ אֶל־ מוֹצָ֣א הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה רִפִּ֙אתִי֙ לַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה מִשָּׁ֛ם ע֖וֹד מָ֥וֶת וּמְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃

passages.text: And the waters there have been healthy to this day, according to the word spoken by Elisha.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of the LORD.
Elisha spoke a word about the water in the city.
The water became healthy after Elisha spoke.
The water has remained healthy until today.
This happened just as Elisha said.
passages.original: וַיֵּרָפ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּדְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָׁ֖ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃פ

passages.text: From there, Elisha went up to Bethel, and as he was walking up the road, a group of boys came out of the city and jeered at him, chanting, “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of the LORD.
Elisha left the place where he had healed the water.
Elisha went up to Bethel.
Elisha walked along the road.
A group of young boys came out from the city.
The boys saw Elisha.
The boys mocked Elisha.
The boys shouted at him.
They said, “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!”
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְה֣וּא׀ עֹלֶ֣ה בַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וּנְעָרִ֤ים קְטַנִּים֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־ בוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵ֖חַ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: Then he turned around, looked at them, and called down a curse on them in the name of the LORD. Suddenly two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of the LORD.
A group of boys came out of the city and mocked Elisha.
Elisha turned around.
He saw the boys.
He cursed them in the name of the LORD.
Two female bears came out of the woods.
The bears attacked the boys.
The bears mauled forty-two of the boys.
passages.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן אַֽחֲרָיו֙ וַיִּרְאֵ֔ם וַֽיְקַלְלֵ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַתֵּצֶ֨אנָה שְׁתַּ֤יִם דֻּבִּים֙ מִן־ הַיַּ֔עַר וַתְּבַקַּ֣עְנָה מֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנֵ֖י יְלָדִֽים׃

passages.text: And Elisha went on to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
Elisha left Bethel.
He traveled to Mount Carmel.
After that, Elisha left Mount Carmel.
He returned to Samaria.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם אֶל־ הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וּמִשָּׁ֖ם שָׁ֥ב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
